balls.text: inswinging full toss hits him low on the pads outside the line of leg, stifled appeal
front foot pull and and Suman at deep square leg just manages to come across and stop it, the throw isnt great and Shah  manages to dive on time
nice shot! Drops it a bit short and Shah bends his knee and clubs him over deep square leg
makes room and squeezes out a yorker to the off side
another slower ball but it's a low full toss thudded to mid-off, that's Shah's fifty,he might want to wave his bat in the direction of the Delhi - which didn't give him a chance last year
oh well bowled! Well disguised leg cutter there, Shah is completely fooled
another short delivery but it is legal, mathews swings and misses
bouncer there and it's too high, Mathews has another workout
stays back and clubs him down to long-on
forced to the on side for a single
short delivery and he swishes hard but only at thin air, he curses himself for missing out
you can't bowl length and expect to get away with it, Mathews stays at the crease and a free swing of the arms sees him clear long-on
take that! Mathews makes  a bit of room to a pitched up delivery outside off, drives hard and fast past mid-off, beats the fielder in the deep
poor delivery and a poor over, a low full toss is clubbed away wide of midwicket, big gap there
makes room and forces it wide of long-on
makes room and swings it down to long-on
another full toss, but much lower, he shovels it hard and fast to long-on
full on the off stump and driven to the on side
high full toss  and he biffs it to deep squareleg, the umpires consult about the height and it's called a no-ball
warm welcome to the crease for Suman! Comes round the wicket and bowls a length ball, Mathews takes him downtown and sends the ball soaring over deep midwicket, that's his fifty!
he bowls a length ball and gets duly punished, mathews makes a bit of room and lofts him cleanly through the line, clears long-off
excellent follow up shot, Shah gets his bat down on an angle and squeezes out a full delivery off the meat of the bat and beats backward point
seemed like a top edge but that travelled, Shah gets on his knee and carts that high over fine leg, he plays that shot well
Shah moves a long way wide of the leg stump but can only drive straight to cover
gets beside the line and chops it towards cover
poor delivery, there's no midwicket and there's a big gap in the deep, Mathews goes back and slaps it
chopped towards covers
pushed to the off side and they think of a second run but change their minds
stays back and forces it away past midwicket, Ojha dropped it a bit too short there
full outside off and pushed to the off side
slog sweeps don't get cleaner than that! Shah gets on his knee early, picks the pitched up delivery from middle and in one clean swipe clears long leg, terrific sight
full on the off stump and he pushes it to the off side
low inswinging full toss and he knocks it to the on side
tucks him up for room, he punches it to long-on
cramps him for room again, leans back and cuts
good restrictive bowling there, leans forward and finds cover
takes a couple of paces down and checks his shot and punches it down to mid-off
tries to pierce the gap at cover
turned to the on side
tossed up on the pads and tapped back to the bowler
tucked behind square on the on side and a fumble allows a single
oops, loses his direction and slips it down the leg side
tries to jam it out of the blockhole, good swing there
gets beside the line and cuts to deep point
full on the pads and pushed through the line to long-on
gets forward to a full delivery and drives to cover
full on the pads and worked to square leg
full on middle and tucked towards midwicket
he must be taking lessons from Dilshan there! Moves across his stumps to a low full toss and easily paddles it over short fine leg
great shot, what a player! Mathews chips down the track to a length ball and slams it over mid-on, nice follow through
short and he swishes hard at it, Gilchrist thinks he;s hit it but the umpire is unmoved
Mathews nearly lost his balance there, Jaskaran pitches it full and Mathews yorks himself, the ball hits his pads outside the line of leg
elegant pull but there's protection at deep square leg, nicely timed
pushes it back to the bowler, Deccan still have them on a leash here
drifts down the leg side and he half attempts to play it away
bowls it fuller and gets it to loop towards the right-hander, he pushes it straight to Vaas at sweeper cover
punches it straight to cover
chops it hard to the off side but he can't beat backward point
on the pads and tucked to fine leg
gets beside the line and cuts to sweeper cover
full on off stump but he can't beat mid-off, good over
tries to force it through but can't beat the bowler
pushed square on the off side and the fielder does his best to dive
pinches a single to the on side and rushes through
steers it to the off side, thinks of a single but then heads back
well bowled, stump to stump and Mathews defends with a dead bat
tucks it to the deep and Jaskaran has a bit of work to do, they complete the second run
places it down to third man for a single
Symonds flings himself to his right and intercepts a drive
tucks it to the deep on the on side and they push hard for the second run
drifts on middle and leg and he works it down to fine leg
on target and Shah defends back to the bowler
comes down and forces it down to long-on, lot of wrist work on that shot
pushes it through quicker and he defends
defends with soft hands
stays back and cuts wide of point
comes down the track very early but checks his shot, defends
stays back and defends with soft hands
stays behind the line and defends with soft hands
full and wide outside off and he reaches out and he scoops it in the air over cover, there's protection in the deep
full on the pads and he forces it away towards fine leg, Jaskaran gets across quickly and mops up
on the pads and he flicks it wide of square leg, Jaskaran's there at long leg to cut it off
chops it down to the off side
that's a poor delivery and well put away, he leans into a half volley and drives firmly past cover, the fielder gives the chase but the ball beats him
close call for Mathews! He comes down the track and forces it to mid-on and risks Suman's arm, the throw was just wide
gets forward and steers it down to point, the infield is packed and alert
lands it on a good length outside off and tapped down to the covers
bowls a jaffa outside the off stump, squares up a tentative Mathews
That's an interesting way to get off the mark, he seizes onto a short delivery and hooks it directly above the keeper's head, the ball lands just over the rope

Deccan are chipping away relentlessly! Jaskaran drops it a fraction short outside off and invites the slash, Hodge gets in position to smack that but finds Gibbs at short point who falls backward after cupping it, great field placement
nice angle across the right-hander and well left by Shah
stays behind the line and defends to the off side
another soft dismissal! RP pitches it up on middle and leg and Pujara was already a couple of paces forward from the crease when he played it, ends up tamely chipping it to Ojha at mid-on
angles it across the right-hander, safely left alone
drops it down to backward point and risks the single
too wide outside off again, he's not able to control the movement
whack! RP pitches it up on off and middle and he's punished for bowling that length, Hodge swings it over deep midwicket, nice follow through
RP switches ends but sprays it very wide of the off stump,the batsman thinks of playing at it but misses
fires it full on the off stump and he forces it down to Suman at mid-off
drops it short and he pulls firmly down to fine leg
Hodge chips down the track early but Jaskaran drops it a bit short and as a result Hodge fails to make contact
friendly inswinging full toss on middle and he helps it on its way to Vaas at long leg
much better, Hodge knocks it down to midwicket for a single
closer to the stumps but still too wide, gets beside the line and slashes it hard and along the turf past backward point
poor start for Jaskaran, too wide outside off, more of a loosener
defends softly again and the ball rolls to mid-off
close call! Defends with soft hands and the ball spins backwards close to his stumps
tucks it to midwicket and tells his partner to wait
poor line again from Vaas, again on the pads and he flicks it to fine leg again but much squarer this time, big gap there
he's punished for bowling the wrong line, down the leg side and he easily glances it to the fine leg boundary
gets it to curve back in through the air and he gets forward and plays across the line to the on side
nice delivery, teases him to go for the cut but the ball cuts back in and cramps him up for room
kicks up a bit more outside off and he gets beside the line and cuts hard to third man
steers it to the off side and tells his partner to wait
the first of IPL 3, he leans onto a half volley outside off and drives wide of cover, nice timing and placement
lands it outside off and he gets behind the line and pats it away
lands it outside off and the right-hander lets it go and gauges the away movement
comes back off the seam, close call as he just gets his bat behind the line
tries to work it off his pads and there's a stifled appeal for a lbw, that was missing leg
caught first slip! You have to give credit to Vaas for setting it up, he gets another one to move off the seam, this time fuller outside off, draws Ganguly forward and first slip takes it comfortably
nice movement off the seam again, this time he's surer of his off stump and shoulders arms
and nearly edges it, he reaches out to a delivery outside off, the late movement saves him
what a start! Soft dismissal there, Vaas drifts on the pads and forces Tiwary to play at it, he gets forward and tamely lobs it to Rohit at midwicket, catching practice there
Kolkata have done it! Ishant beats the bat once again with the final delivery and Ganguly sprints in with joy on his face as fireworks light up the DY Patil Stadium
played down the ground for one run only, Kolkata are on the brink of victory
terrific save on the deep backward square leg boundary! The fielder sprints across on the boundary, throws himself full length, and swats the ball back in

Ishant what are you doing? He pulled off a spectacular dive to field a straight drive, he then tries to throw hard at the non striker's end and concedes an over throw, he needn't have thrown, he could have got up, ambled to the stumps and knocked off the bails
full ball outside off stump, Suman swings across the line and misses, the keeper collects and runs to the stumps to prevent them stealing a bye
Ishant makes amends with a terrific slower ball, Suman didn't know what was happening and got beaten
wide! Full and down leg side, oh it's a no ball as well! So free hit, Ishant what are you doing?
low full toss, driven hard down the ground, only a single
bouncer, it's too high and it's been called wide
full toss, the batsman hits it down the ground for one, Deccan need more
Jaskaran Singh has a wild swing at a short ball from Langeveldt. Misses.

bowled him! Langeveldt's doing it for KKR! Good length and straight from the bowler, Vaas aims for midwicket and misses, the ball hits the top of middle stump, Vaas struck with his first ball and now goes first ball
he's driven it into the stumps at the bowler's end, else he would have got two for that shot
Suman lets Langeveldt know what he's up to by backing away too early, Langeveldt delivers wide outside off, Suman lets it go and looks expectantly at the umpire
caught!! Anirudh tries to pull this time and the ball hits high on the bat, it lobs up behind the bolwer and Shukla reacts quickly, running back to hold the caught and bowled, he is pumped!
super placement! Anirudh gets under the full ball and muscles it over the umpire's head for four
played back to the bowler and Shukla fields well, that shy at the stumps at the striker's end was unnecessary though, Kolkata don't want to risk overthrows
Anirudh chips the ball over cover once again, two more, they are running hard between wickets
full toss outside off stump, the batsman bends down low and scoops the ball over cover, they hurry back for the second
beaten outside the off stump, Shukla notches up a dot
Thirumalasetti Suman! Terrific shot! He picks up a length delivery off his pads and launches it towards the wide long on boundary, it bounces just before the rope
hit in the air towards long off, bounces once before reaching the fielder
cut off the back foot, straight to point, dot ball, it's gold.
superb slower ball outside off stump, Anirudh gets beaten

massive wicket! Sharma plays the weirdest of shots, he backs away to a short ball and plays a forehand-ish shot, like a slice, straight to Hodge at mid-off, he had to run a few paces to his right to take the catch, Kolkata are right back in this now
Sharma moves across his stumps to work a length ball to fine leg but misses, the fine leg was up so the shot was on
full toss, hit down the ground to long on for a single
short of a length on middle stump, pulled through midwicket for a single
Anirudh tries to hook a short one and gets a top edge towards fine leg
played off the hips through square leg for one
hit to mid-on for a quick single
Shukla angles a good length delivery across the left-hander, Anirudh chases and gets beaten
lovely placement and timing, Sharma moves forward and across, and drives a full ball wide of the fielder at mid on
left alone outside off stump, not too often I get to type that out in a Twenty20, Sharma lifted his bat out of the way of a short of a length ball just outside off
he's away by steering the ball towards third man for a single
played off the back foot towards deep backward point
he's cut him in half with one that pitches around off and nips back in, the ball threads the bat-pad gap and just misses the stumps

it does! He sends down a length delivery and Symonds heaves at it, the top edge soars towards midwicket where Ganguly positions himself under the ball. It takes a while to come down but when it does, it lands in Ganguly's safe hands
that's well played! Sharma waits in his crease and opens the face late to cut the ball behind point for a four
Symonds rocks back and cuts the ball in front of point for another single
now he gets down on one knee and plays a delicate paddle sweep to short fine leg
Symonds defends tentatively on the front foot
pushed off the front foot through point for  a single
driven off the front foot on the off side
length delivery outside off stump, Symonds cuts to point
full ball on the pads, flicked elegantly towards deep midwicket
driven through point for a single
Langeveldt digs in a bouncer that really takes off, Symonds misses the hook and Saha jumps up but can't collect it, the ball hits his gloves and goes for four byes
he's holed out! Gibbs clears his leg and slams the ball down the ground, he's connected with the bottom of his bat and Mathews holds the catch on the long off boundary
and he beats him! Gibbs pokes at a length delivery and the ball misses the edge
turned off the pads for a single
played to midwicket, Symonds wanted one but Gibbs didn't, the fielder picked up and threw the ball straight into the umpire!
he advances again and biffs the ball down the ground to long off
Symonds advances and gets yorked
nudged off the pads for a single to short fine leg, Deccan reach 100
caught! Gilchrist moves back and tries to clear the square leg boundary, he doesn't hit it cleanly and Tiwary runs to his left and takes a smart catch on the move, is it too late for Kolkata though?
full ball, Gibbs leans forward and flicks through midwicket, long on has to run to his right to prevent the boundary
the slower bouncer and Gibbs plays it splendidly! He moves across and rolls his wrists, helping the ball along towards the fine leg boundary
how did that miss the stumps? Gibbs tried to pull but was beaten by the slower ball that went over the stumps, terrific change of pace
length delivery, Gibbs makes room and swings his bat hard, launching the ball towards the deep midwicket boundary
slower ball and Gilchrist tries to play his pick up shot over square leg, he ends up lofting it towards fine leg and the ball falls safely as three fielders converge on it
yorker, and Gilchrist has a bit of trouble keeping it out
Gibbs pulls uppishly but the ball falls short of Shukla at midwicket
Hodge floats on leg stump, Gilchrist waits in his crease and pulls to deep square leg
played through square leg for two more
lovely shot! Gilchrist brings up fifty by skipping down the pitch and lofting inside out with the turn over extra cover, all the way for six!
Gibbs moves back and across and pulls towards deep square leg
driven towards long off for a single
slower ball outside off, Gilchrist waits and dabs towards third man
pulled towards deep midwicket for one

dropped! Gilchrist goes after Mathews, lofting a length delivery down the ground, Langeveldt runs to his right from long off, he gets to it and slides but can't hold on, Kolkata have dropped Gilchrist twice now, you can't afford that.
just short of  a length and straight, Gibbs moves across and pulls towards long leg
slower ball on off stump, Gibbs comes forward and blocks
wide outside off stump, Gilchrist reaches out but mis-times it to cover, Hodge fumbles
that's wide outside off stump, Gilchrist can't reach it
oh Gibbs tries to smack that down the ground but the pace was slower and he was beaten outside off stump
bowled quick and straight, Gibbs defends towards the bowler
defended on the front foot towards point
short again and Gilchrist has enough time to move back and pull to deep backward square
he tries to sweep this time but doesn't make proper contact, gets a single to short fine leg
slightly short outside off, Gibbs waits and punches the ball off the back foot through cover
played off the pads through square leg for a single

Gibbs tried to work the ball on the leg side but got hit on the pad, Gilchrist set off, Gibbs responded and then decided to go back. Mathews tears down the pitch, picks up, dives and throws, he misses the stumps, Gibbs might have been out
short of a length outside off, Gilchrist steers towards third man
not that short this time but Gibbs quickly gets into position and swats the ball to long leg
the slower bouncer! And Mathews beats Gibbs'  attempted hook comprehensively
he's over-stepped, Gibbs defends on the off side, he won't be defending the free hit coming up
steered towards third man for a single
pushed towards mid-off for a quick single

Laxman tries it again but he's holed out this time. Laxman and ugly hoicks don't gel. He cleared his front foot again and tried to bash it over the leg side, the top edge went straight up in the air and Kartik settled under the catch
jumps out of his crease and plays towards midwicket for a single
Gilchrist hits the ball past the bowler and a poor attempt by the fielder at mid-off, Angelo Mathews, fails to cut it off
quicker ball and straight, Gilchrist defends towards Kartik
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Gilchrist plays off the back foot on the off side
have you ever seen Laxman clear his front foot out of the way, wind up against a length ball and smash it high over long on? He just did that
Gilchrist tries to cut and gets a thick bottom edge into the ground, the single brings up the 50 partnership
he's mis-timed the pull, hitting it high on the bat, but just clears the fielder at midwicket
huge! Gilchrist gets under a length ball and lofts it straight and clean, back over the bowler's head for six
Gilchrist swats a length delivery back hard, forcing Laxman to duck, but he doesn't beat mid off
good length outside off, steered towards third man off the back foot
the slower ball at 119 kmh, Gilchrist waits for it, waits for it, and dabs towards mid-off
good length ball around off stump, Laxman runs the ball towards third man
Gilchrist tries to hit over square leg again but gets an inside edge behind square
the slower ball this time and Laxman tries to loft over midwicket, he mis-times it in the air but the ball lands safely, Ishant has no luck today
Laxman pulls a short ball through midwicket
the fielder at mid-on didn't move! Laxman backed away and played an ugly slog down the ground to a full ball, it's not very often you see him bat like that! But it was effective.
shot! Full length on the pads and Gilchrist flicks the ball, or does he scoop it? He sends it soaring over the boundary at deep square leg
he tries to hit straight down the ground but mis-times it, he's hit it well enough to clear the fielder at mid-off though
the length isn't short at all but Gilchrist plays that favourite shot of his through square
pulled towards long leg for a single

shot! The length wasn't bad at all but Laxman moved back and quickly punched the ball between extra cover and mid off, Ganguly gives chase and look at him dive! Full length and desperate! He can't stop the four though
full and straight, Laxman plays on the leg side
edged and four! Gilchrist moves across and pokes at a delivery angling across him, this time the edge flies wide of the slips and runs to the third man boundary
length delivery on leg and middle, fairly decent ball but Gilchrist clears his front foot and swings the ball through square leg for the innings' first boundary
short and wide outside off stump, Laxman chases and slashes, slicing the ball in the air but well short of the fielder at third man
short of a length outside off stump, pacy delivery, and Laxman fends and misses

edged and dropped! Gilchrist stays in his crease and tries to steer a length delivery towards third man, he gets an edge towards Hodge's left at second slip, he dives to try and take a tough catch but floors it, big miss
Gilchrist winds up and attempts the pull but the ball is down leg side, the third wide of the innings
good length and straight, Gilchrist stays in his crease and opens the face to play the ball towards point
another skiddy delivery from Langeveldt around off stump, the ball was on Gilchrist before he played the pull and he ended up swatting it to square leg
good length once again, Gilchrist plays toward midwicket

Laxman closes the face to play towards leg and gets a leading edge towards mid off. And look at Ganguly! He covers good ground to his left, picks up and throws at the bowler's end, putting pressure on Laxman
edged and just short! Laxman feels for a good length ball outside off and gets a thick edge that dies on the fielder at first slip, reaches him just on the bounce

Gilchrist gets hit on the pad by a full and fast delivery, there's an appeal for lbw which is not given, that was missing leg, Laxman is ambling for the run and there's a direct hit at the striker's end, Laxman's just safe
fuller length but the line is down leg side, another wide, if Gilchrist's connects with those, they'll disappear
short ball and wide down leg side, Gilchrist can't reach it with the pull
Langeveldt zips the first one from a good length into Gilchrist's pads, he was cramped for room as he tried to close the face
